code: Clear[s,n,r,b,d,Dd,x]; F[z_] := 4 s z^2 - (n + 2 s) z - 2 s; disc = Sqrt[n^2 + 4 n s + 36 s^2]; rs = -4 s/(n + 2 s + disc); rootCheck = FullSimplify[F[rs], Assumptions -> n > 0 && Element[s, Reals]]; slopeCheck = FullSimplify[D[F[r], r] /. r -> rs, Assumptions -> n > 0 && Element[s, Reals]]; shiftCheck = Expand[F[b + d] - F[b] - ((8 s b - n - 2 s) d + 4 s d^2)]; cone = {F[-1/2], F[1]}; {rootCheck, slopeCheck, shiftCheck, cone}
